Validate runtime copy against original exact bytes and comparison digest, prover control/config/ownership, timer target/deadline and explicit-stop argv/terminal digest. Derive containment from exact owned-resource observations and authenticated generations; validate all scalar types and closed evidence content. findings.title: Authenticated refusal still infers no resource start from missing progress

findings.observed: The actual reader accepts an invocation-bound REFUSED result with evidence=[]/containmentComplete=true and no owners. With completed handshake and no progress, _disposition_for returns refused even without acknowledgment. Missing startup/launched messages are treated as independent proof that resources never started. AF_UNIX fragment loss is independently reproduced in G1-10.

Null-identity reports remain diagnostic. Add actual handshake plus omission/fragment controls and preserve active ownership when no-start is not independently established.

findings.title: Absolute bootstrap and timer deadlines remain ineffective
findings.predicate: P04/P05/P08: bootstrap hard exit by outer+1606; independent timer at +1620, accuracy at most one second, surviving parent loss.
findings.observed: Final formula is floor((bootstrap-now)/1s)-1. For now100.950/cut1606/activation102.050 it schedules1606.050, so a one-second reserve is not a bound. Post-start rejection cannot enforce termination after parent loss or absent ownership. The unit command contains no absolute monotonic bootstrap supervisor. Actual fake-service execution with timerNextElapseOffsetSeconds=4 accepts NextElapse3.130901686s after cutoff and returns PROCESS_SUCCESS/0; validator allows +/-5s and never requests/checks AccuracyUSec.
findings.expected: Use a narrow source-bound absolute CLOCK_MONOTONIC supervisor for the financial child, instantiated before financial work, binding the authenticated outer start, boot/time domain and +1606 cutoff. It must refuse late entry, terminate its owned process group by the absolute cutoff even if executor/parent dies before durable startup, and preserve actual main exit semantics. RuntimeMax may remain defense in depth. Test real short-lived local child probes with delayed activation both sides of fractional boundaries, parent loss before/after startup, TERM-resistant child, and exact absolute cutoff; retain PID absence/reaping evidence without global reaping. Anchor timer to actual absolute target and validate target, NextElapse and Accuracy<=1s; do not widen tolerance or subtract another arbitrary margin.

findings.title: Persistence and release restart budgets beyond the shared completion cutoff
findings.predicate: P04/P05/P07/P12: all cleanup/result/ack/ownership transitions share original absolute bounds, retaining outer margin.
findings.observed: A real exclusive result write with injected now1741 and cleanup1740 persists successfully because _write_result uses outer1800. Accounting _replace_file grants a fresh25s to write then another25s to rename/fsync, repeated for three handover files and release; BudgetLock gets its own5s without original cutoff. Release occurs after child acknowledgment and has no shared +1740 bound. Detached cleanup main derives a fresh now+bound and then grants another full bound to durable save. Individual worker supervision is improved, but cumulative/late admission remains unbounded against required schedule.
findings.expected: Pass the authenticated original deadline through every lock/write/rename/fsync/cleanup/result/release boundary. Compute remaining time immediately before each operation, never a new full budget; refuse/retain unresolved when no time remains. Include writer/fsync stalls reached near cutoff and interrupted rename outcome, and prove no work or acknowledgment is newly granted in the last outer margin.
